```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE, fig.width = 9)

library(dplyr)
library(readr)
library(tidyr)
library(purrr)
library(stringr)
library(ggplot2)
library(forcats)
library(scales)
library(knitr)

theme_set(theme_minimal(base_size = 12))
```

```{r load-data, include=FALSE}
data_dir <- "../data"

state_dirs <- list.dirs(data_dir, recursive = FALSE, full.names = FALSE)
state_dirs <- sort(state_dirs[grepl("^[A-Z]{2}$", state_dirs)])

has_rate_mmr <- function(state) {
  f <- file.path(data_dir, state, "standard", "data.csv.gz")
  if (!file.exists(f)) return(FALSE)
  nm <- names(read_csv(f, n_max = 0, show_col_types = FALSE))
  all(c("geography", "time", "grade", "rate_mmr") %in% nm)
}

mmr_states <- state_dirs[map_lgl(state_dirs, has_rate_mmr)]
mmr_states <- setdiff(mmr_states, c("AK", "ND"))

# For states that report more than one grade, keep the kindergarten (or the
# nearest school-entry-equivalent) cohort so one row represents one
# county-year, matching the WaPo/CDC school-entry convention.
pick_entry_grade <- function(df) {
  g <- unique(df$grade)
  if (any(str_detect(g, regex("kind", ignore_case = TRUE)))) {
    df <- filter(df, str_detect(grade, regex("kind", ignore_case = TRUE)))
  } else if ("Overall" %in% g) {
    df <- filter(df, grade == "Overall")
  } else if ("Totals" %in% g) {
    df <- filter(df, grade == "Totals")
  }
  df
}

read_state_mmr <- function(state) {
  f <- file.path(data_dir, state, "standard", "data.csv.gz")
  df <- read_csv(f, col_types = cols(
    geography = col_character(),
    geography_name = col_character(),
    time = col_date(),
    grade = col_character(),
    rate_mmr = col_double()
  ), col_select = any_of(c("geography", "geography_name", "time", "grade", "rate_mmr")))
  df <- pick_entry_grade(df)
  df %>%
    mutate(
      state_abb = state,
      year_start = as.integer(format(time, "%Y")),
      geography = str_pad(geography, 5, pad = "0")
    ) %>%
    filter(!is.na(rate_mmr), rate_mmr > 0.3, rate_mmr <= 1) %>%
    select(state_abb, geography, geography_name, year_start, rate_mmr) %>%
    distinct(state_abb, geography, year_start, .keep_all = TRUE)
}

ours <- map_dfr(mmr_states, read_state_mmr)

wapo_url <- paste0(
  "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/washingtonpost/",
  "data-school-vaccination-rates/refs/heads/main/vaxrates_counties.csv"
)

wapo_raw <- read_csv(wapo_url, show_col_types = FALSE)

wapo <- wapo_raw %>%
  transmute(
    state_abb = state_abb,
    geography = str_pad(as.character(fiptxt), 5, pad = "0"),
    county_name = str_to_title(county),
    `2018` = `2018-2019`,
    `2019` = `2019-2020`,
    `2023` = `2023-2024`,
    `2024` = `2024-2025`
  ) %>%
  pivot_longer(c(`2018`, `2019`, `2023`, `2024`),
               names_to = "year_start", values_to = "wapo_rate") %>%
  mutate(year_start = as.integer(year_start), wapo_rate = wapo_rate / 100) %>%
  filter(!is.na(wapo_rate))

# Tennessee's WaPo county figure is overridden downstream by PopHIVE's own
# ingest with the TN DOH file (per DATA_SOURCES.md, WaPo's raw TN numbers are
# considered unreliable), so compare our TN data against PopHIVE's processed
# schoolvax_washpost output rather than the raw WaPo CSV above.
pophive_counties_url <- paste0(
  "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/PopHIVE/Ingest/main/",
  "data/schoolvax_washpost/standard/data_counties.csv.gz"
)

wapo_tn_pophive <- read_csv(pophive_counties_url, show_col_types = FALSE) %>%
  transmute(
    state_abb = "TN",
    geography = str_pad(as.character(geography), 5, pad = "0"),
    county_name = NA_character_,
    year_start = as.integer(format(time, "%Y")),
    wapo_rate = wapo_county_vax_rate / 100
  ) %>%
  filter(str_starts(geography, "47"), !is.na(wapo_rate))

# Swap in the standard (PopHIVE-processed, TN-DOH-overridden) TN rows
# everywhere `wapo` is used, not just in the Tennessee-specific section.
wapo <- wapo %>%
  filter(state_abb != "TN") %>%
  bind_rows(wapo_tn_pophive)
```

## Latest year of our data, by state

```{r latest-year}
latest_year_for <- function(state) {
  f <- file.path(data_dir, state, "standard", "data.csv.gz")
  if (!file.exists(f)) return(NA_integer_)
  nm <- names(read_csv(f, n_max = 0, show_col_types = FALSE))
  if (!"time" %in% nm) return(NA_integer_)
  d <- read_csv(f, col_types = cols(time = col_date()), col_select = "time")
  if (!nrow(d) || all(is.na(d$time))) return(NA_integer_)
  max(as.integer(format(d$time, "%Y")), na.rm = TRUE)
}

tibble(state_abb = state_dirs) %>%
  mutate(latest_year_num = map_int(state_abb, latest_year_for)) %>%
  group_by(latest_year_num) %>%
  summarise(states = paste(sort(state_abb), collapse = ", "), .groups = "drop") %>%
  arrange(desc(latest_year_num)) %>%
  mutate(latest_year = if_else(is.na(latest_year_num), "Not yet ingested", as.character(latest_year_num))) %>%
  select(latest_year, states) %>%
  kable(col.names = c("Year", "States"))
```

## Matched county-year coverage

```{r matched}
matched <- inner_join(ours, wapo, by = c("state_abb", "geography", "year_start")) %>%
  mutate(diff = rate_mmr - wapo_rate, avg = (rate_mmr + wapo_rate) / 2)
```

```{r availability-tile, fig.height=6}
avail <- full_join(
  ours %>% distinct(state_abb, year_start) %>% mutate(has_ours = TRUE),
  wapo %>% distinct(state_abb, year_start) %>% mutate(has_wapo = TRUE),
  by = c("state_abb", "year_start")
) %>%
  filter(state_abb %in% unique(matched$state_abb) | state_abb %in% unique(ours$state_abb)) %>%
  mutate(
    coverage = case_when(
      coalesce(has_ours, FALSE) & coalesce(has_wapo, FALSE) ~ "Both",
      coalesce(has_ours, FALSE) ~ "Our ingest only",
      coalesce(has_wapo, FALSE) ~ "WaPo only"
    )
  )

ggplot(avail, aes(x = factor(year_start), y = fct_rev(state_abb), fill = coverage)) +
  geom_tile(color = "white", linewidth = 0.4) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c(
    "Both" = "#31a354",
    "Our ingest only" = "#2c7fb8",
    "WaPo only" = "#d95f0e"
  )) +
  labs(x = "School year (start)", y = NULL, fill = NULL,
       title = "County-level MMR-rate coverage by source, state, and year")
```

## Our rate vs. WaPo rate, matched county-years

```{r scatter, fig.height=7}
ggplot(matched, aes(x = wapo_rate, y = rate_mmr, color = state_abb)) +
  geom_abline(slope = 1, intercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "grey40") +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.6, size = 1.6) +
  scale_x_continuous(labels = percent_format(accuracy = 1)) +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = percent_format(accuracy = 1)) +
  coord_equal() +
  labs(x = "WaPo county MMR rate", y = "Our ingest county MMR rate", color = "State",
       title = "County-year MMR coverage: our ingest vs. Washington Post")
```

```{r scatter-facet, fig.height=8}
ggplot(matched, aes(x = wapo_rate, y = rate_mmr)) +
  geom_abline(slope = 1, intercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "grey60") +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.5, size = 1, color = "#2c7fb8") +
  scale_x_continuous(labels = percent_format(accuracy = 1)) +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = percent_format(accuracy = 1)) +
  facet_wrap(~state_abb) +
  labs(x = "WaPo county MMR rate", y = "Our ingest county MMR rate",
       title = "Same comparison, faceted by state")
```

## Time series, both sources

```{r timeseries, fig.height=10}
ts_ours <- ours %>%
  group_by(state_abb, year_start) %>%
  summarise(rate = mean(rate_mmr), .groups = "drop") %>%
  mutate(source = "Our ingest")

ts_wapo <- wapo %>%
  filter(state_abb %in% unique(ours$state_abb)) %>%
  group_by(state_abb, year_start) %>%
  summarise(rate = mean(wapo_rate), .groups = "drop") %>%
  mutate(source = "WaPo")

bind_rows(ts_ours, ts_wapo) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = year_start, y = rate, color = source)) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 0.8) +
  geom_point(size = 1.5) +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = percent_format(accuracy = 1)) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("Our ingest" = "#2c7fb8", "WaPo" = "#d95f0e")) +
  facet_wrap(~state_abb, ncol = 3) +
  labs(x = "School year (start)", y = "State-average county MMR rate", color = NULL,
       title = "State-average MMR coverage over time, by source")
```

## Louisiana by parish

```{r louisiana, fig.height=6}
la <- inner_join(
  ours %>% filter(state_abb == "LA"),
  wapo %>% filter(state_abb == "LA"),
  by = c("state_abb", "geography", "year_start")
)

ggplot(la, aes(x = wapo_rate, y = rate_mmr)) +
  geom_abline(slope = 1, intercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "grey50") +
  geom_point(color = "#3182bd", size = 2, alpha = 0.7) +
  scale_x_continuous(labels = percent_format(accuracy = 1)) +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = percent_format(accuracy = 1)) +
  coord_equal() +
  labs(x = "WaPo county MMR rate", y = "LA DOH county MMR rate (our ingest)",
       title = "Louisiana: state-supplied figures vs. WaPo's county estimate")
```
